description: Points www or a chosen subdomain at the Seitenigel website platform. Group 'prepare' adds the two Cloudflare custom-hostname validation records first, so the certificate is ready before the switch; group 'switch' then adds the CNAME. Mail records are never touched.
variableDescription: %owntxt%: the Cloudflare custom-hostname ownership token, minted per hostname. %acmetxt%: the certificate DCV token for the same hostname. Both are opaque single-purpose values prescribed by Cloudflare and cannot carry a prefix.
